turnaround_reason: Stock is down ~51% from its 52-week high despite Q1 2026 beating on both revenue ($133.7M vs $131.6M est.) and EPS ($0.09 vs $0.08 est.) and management reaffirming FY26 guidance — the sell-off looks driven by broader growth-deceleration and margin-normalization worries in the MSP-software space rather than company-specific deterioration.
bullish_points: Revenue growth of 13.1% ttm is real and reaccelerating, unlike the other two names screened today
Reaffirmed FY26 guidance (ARR $581-586M, adjusted EBITDA $167-171M, 8-9% constant-currency ARR growth, 30-31% EBITDA margin) with no guide-down
Forward PE of only 9.2x and price-to-book of ~1.0x is cheap for a software company with 80% gross margins
Actively buying back stock — 1.29M shares repurchased for ~$10M in the latest tranche, ~$29.9M total under the March 2025 program
Launched new AI-powered detection in its Adlumin-based Security Operations Center, adding a real product-driven growth angle
Analyst recommendation is "buy" with 5 analysts covering; Scotiabank raised its target post-earnings
bearish_points: Debt/equity of 54.5% and total debt of $436M against a modest $828M market cap leaves less room for error than the balance sheet-light peers
Needham cut its price target to $6.50 (from $8) even while maintaining Buy — some estimate trimming is happening despite the beat-and-raise quarter
Extremely high implied vol on the options (108% ATM IV at the Nov sampled expiry) signals the market is pricing real uncertainty, not a sleepy value name
No activist stake or M&A catalyst found in research — the re-rating thesis depends purely on execution, not a corporate action shortcut
Trailing PE not meaningful (net loss on a trailing basis) — profitability improvement is still a story, not yet fully proven out
catalyst: Q2 earnings — confirmation that ARR growth and EBITDA margin trends from Q1 are continuing, which would validate the reaffirmed FY26 guide
suggested_trade: Spot position, or Jan 2027 $5/$7.50 call spread given liquid options (8,668 call OI) and cheap forward multiple
key_risk: MSP-software peer group re-rates lower on macro SMB-spending worries, dragging NABL down regardless of its own execution, or leverage becomes a concern if growth stalls
would_skip_if: Q2 shows ARR growth decelerating below the 8% guided floor or any sign of the buyback pausing due to leverage concerns
